request.answer: After the Initial Term, this Agreement renews automatically for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party gives writen notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term. Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of the invoice date. Overdue amounts accrue interest at the rate of 1.5% per month, or the highest rate permitted by law if lower, from the due date until paid.

request.instructions: The source is one version of an agreement. Each claim is a sentence taken from the other version of the same agreement. A claim is supported when the source states the same obligation, right, amount, rate, period, party and place, even if the wording, spelling, punctuation or number formatting differs. A claim is contradicted when the source states something different about any of those. Judge each claim against the passage of the source that covers the same subject.
